[atm-surcharges] ATM owner surcharges and our fees (effective 2025-01-01)
When you use an ATM outside BrookLink, up to two different charges can apply. They're easy to mix up.

## The ATM owner's surcharge

This is set by whoever owns the ATM, not by us. The ATM shows it on screen before you confirm, and it's added to the withdrawal amount. For example, if you withdraw cash and the owner charges a surcharge, one transaction for the total appears in your activity.

## Tallowbrook's out-of-network fee

This is our fee, charged as a separate line called "Out-of-network ATM fee".

[atm-fees-basic-v1] ATM fees on Basic (effective 2025-01-01)
Here's what ATM withdrawals cost on the Basic plan.

| ATM | Tallowbrook fee |
|---|---|
| BrookLink, in the US | $0.00 |
| Any other ATM in the US | $2.00 |
| ATMs outside the US | $3.00 |

Every out-of-network withdrawal is charged the fee. To avoid it, use a BrookLink ATM.

## Surcharges

ATM owners outside BrookLink can add their own surcharge on top of our fee. The ATM shows it on screen before you confirm.

## Daily limit

You can withdraw up to $1,000 a day on Plus.

## Where fees show up

Any Tallowbrook ATM fee appears as its own line in your activity feed, right after the withdrawal, so you can always see what you paid us and what the ATM owner charged. The app's ATM map shows the nearest BrookLink ATMs.

Customer question:
The ATM charged me a surcharge AND Tallowbrook charged me a fee. Why am I paying twice?

Rules:
- Use only facts stated in the excerpts. Do not add fees, limits, dates, steps or products they do not mention.
- Some excerpts are older versions of a policy. When two excerpts disagree, follow the one with the later effective date.
- If the question depends on the customer's plan (Basic, Plus or Premium), use that plan's numbers.
- If the question rests on something false (for example a fee that does not exist), say so and give the correct facts. That is an answer, not an abstention.
- Abstain when the excerpts do not contain the answer, when the question is not about Tallowbrook, or when it asks for investment, tax or legal advice. Set "abstain" to true and say briefly that the help center does not cover it.
- Cite the article IDs (the text in square brackets) of every excerpt you used. Cite nothing when you abstain.
- Keep the answer short: two to four sentences, plain language.
